🌴 KonkaniBench
	

A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for Konkani language models, featuring multiple-choice questions (MCQ), translation tasks, and transliteration tasks across multiple Konkani scripts.

reputation: A community-created benchmark for the low-resource Konkani language with modest adoption among multilingual/NLP researchers interested in Indic languages.
